purpose: Concrete supplied correct model context for the frozen Source/D competence; no learner independent model-construction demand and no authoritative P profile.

notationGivenToLearner.a/b: sister chromatids of the same duplicated chromosome
notationGivenToLearner.A_m/B_m: maternal variant at each corresponding region of type1
notationGivenToLearner.A_p/B_p: paternal variant at the same corresponding regions

modelA.givenStart: One diploid model cell, chromosome types1 and2, each represented by a maternal and paternal homolog; sister chromatids and centromeres are already labelled. No segment exchange in this comparison.

givenCorrectAlternativeMeiosisComparison.orientation: Homolog origins align together for pairs1/2
Pair2 is reversed relative to pair1

modelA.explanationRequired: Different orientations of separate homologous pairs permit new combinations of already-present genetic information; each gamete still has one chromosome of each type. These are supplied alternative meioses, not eight gametes from one meiosis.

modelB.givenExchange: Corresponding B-region exchange between M1b and P1a, which are non-sister chromatids of homologous chromosomes. A-region and centromere origin stay with the original chromatid.
modelB.explanationRequired: The two exchanged non-sister chromatids carry new combinations of the given corresponding regions; no region or chromosome type is added or lost. Molecular cut/repair details are not asked.
